narrative.overview: The page is one sheet of pale green computation paper from the notebook of a physicist who builds his own instruments. The whole viewport is the sheet, with printed pad furniture that never moves. Content sits on it as in a lab book: typeset slate, ballpoint-blue handwriting, white printouts held by tape.
keyCharacteristics: Grid paper background in light and dark variants.
Printed structure in pad green, content in slate, personal voice in ballpoint blue.
White slips and printouts are the only raised objects, always taped.
One red rubber stamp is the only red. Highlighter yellow only as text selection.
Billing rank: repo printouts sized by stars.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to the stamp and nothing else.

rules.name: The Ink Roles Rule
rules.body: Slate is typeset, blue is the hand, green is the printed pad.

rules.name: The Hand Is Personal Rule
rules.body: Kalam is for the name, entry titles, annotations and the signature, never running prose.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked Condensed exists only as a label inside a printed box or ledger row.

rules.name: The Taped Object Rule
rules.body: Only things that could be taped to the page cast shadows, and each carries tape.

rules.name: The Flat Furniture Rule
rules.body: Header box, ledger and margin get lines, never shadows or fills.

rules.name: The Fixed Regions Rule
rules.body: Header box and margin rule never move or animate.

dos: Do build new content as something that exists on a logbook page.
Do place structure on the 20px cell grid and use multiples of --cell for vertical spacing.
Do keep square corners and tilt only hand-placed objects, by small angles.
Do keep every theme value as a custom property with a dark variant.
Do keep the single entrance motion as the only authored animation and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't add red anywhere but the stamp, or yellow anywhere but text selection.
Don't return to the academic-template column.
Don't use rounded cards, blur, gradients or glass.
Don't set running text in Kalam or tilt printed furniture.
Don't load external fonts, scripts or trackers.
